title: Concept: Jetty version disclosed in a response
description: A Jetty version string in an error page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The version names the servlet container build, and container builds carry their own advisory history separate from the application.
applicability: Deployments that render a Jetty version string in an error page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The version names the servlet container build, and container builds carry their own advisory history separate from the application.
